for_writers: Do not call 90 days the default unused access tracking period (d019): AWS gives the 1-365 day range and 90 days only as an example.
Write the KMS key policy size as 'a maximum length of 32768' (kms-key-policy-max-length), not '32 KB'.
Do not name an error code for a DurationSeconds above the role maximum (d125); AWS says only that the operation fails.

Empty SCP (iam-scp-faq-empty-scp-denies-all): the FAQ says 'equivalent to a policy that explicitly denies all actions'; the effect is the same as an implicit deny. Do not teach it as an explicit Deny statement.

Displays '15 m', '1 hr', '36 hr', '12 hr' of the sts-compare-* rows are the table's own notation; for prose use sts-assumerole-duration-range, sts-getsessiontoken-duration-iam-user and sts-getfederationtoken-duration, whose displays read '900 seconds (15 minutes)' and so on.
